name: War
source:
War might be the second oldest, but she can hardly be called a role model. Brash, loud, and aggressive, she always makes her presence known-often by kicking down the door. She loves the thrill of danger and has a knack for finding trouble.

Her motorcycle is her preferred means of transportation... and the speed limit is optional.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1071877822/talo-episode-one]Kickstarter[/url]]
